## Register and bar (every reviewer)

- Impersonal academic chapter. Named agents + active voice ("the chapter argues," "Floridi
  shows"). **No first person.** The Annals “I searched” rule in repo `CLAUDE.md` does **not**
  apply to this manuscript. House style (`~/.claude/writing-style.md`) is the default *except*
  where this register overrides it: first person is banned here; the venue won.
- APA 7 citations. "Author, 2026" self-cites and any block quotations are **off-limits** as
  prose complaints.
- House cohesion (`CLAUDE.md` eight mechanisms) applies to the flow and style seats: tail-head,
  end-focus, rename the thread entity, weld the gloss, reformulate, forward/backward hooks,
  group parallel evidence.
- Cut the antithesis machine, self-narrating honesty, and metronomic punchy openers. Earned
  definitional contrasts against real neighbors are allowed; decorative ones are not. Agentless
  passives where a named agent is available are defects.
- Scope honesty: core results about Φ live in the companion; this chapter carries the plain
  bypass counterfactual. Flag any place the chapter promises "computable"/formal measures it
  does not deliver here.
- Do not fabricate citations. Flag VERIFY for empirics that look load-bearing and uncited.
- Line numbers refer to the current `chapter.md`. Quote short spans when flagging.
- Sovereignty register (`~/.claude/skills/draft/registers/sovereignty/profile.md`) is
  **uncalibrated**. Do not import Annals or hospitality numeric floors.

## Output format (every review file)

Write to the path assigned below. Structure:

1. **Title block** — lens name, manuscript title, venue, your standpoint.
2. **Step 0 — Register and bar** — confirm the register; state what you will judge hard.
3. **Part 1 — Findings, ranked by damage** — section-aware. For each finding: claim, quote with
   line numbers, why it damages *your* lens, what would fix it. If a section is clean for your
   lens, say so in one sentence and move on.
4. **Part 2 — Seat-specific audit** — content: cases/facts/scope; argument: joints and license;
   flow: cohesion joins; citations: mechanical + load-bearing; style: slop types with quotes.
5. **Part 3 — Paste-ready revisions** — highest-value fixes only, ready to drop in. Style seat:
   worst three stretches only.
6. **Verdict** — major / minor / accept-with-nits. Single most important fix. Biggest genuine
   strength. The one thing only the author can supply (if any).
7. **VERIFY** — empirical or citation claims that need sourcing before press.
8. **Closed-item re-check** — for each of the ten items below, **Holds** / **Regresses** /
   **Not this seat** (one line each). Also re-check the §0j claimed-fixed list.

Be specific. Prefer fewer, sharper findings over a laundry list. Do not soft-pedal; do not invent
problems to fill the form. Each review is a complete critical commentary from its lens.

## Closed findings to re-check (not re-open)

Claimed closed by `HANDOFF.md` / `reviews_v2.md` / `2026-08-02` / morning `2026-08-17` / evening
`2026-08-17-post-fix` / §0g / §0j. Confirm they still hold in the current text.

1. Sovereignty naming defended early (Bodin / specification-not-stretching).
2. §5 separates factoring from bypass; node vs edge demonstrated on a **platform** case (App Store
   payment gate), not only a car dealership. Node test on the payment *rail*, edge test on the
   exclusivity *rule*.
3. Bypass counterfactual restores capability of direct dealing, not a prior relationship.
4. OTA case anchored to 2015–2021 sequence; 2024 CJEU marked too recent for the distribution data.
5. "Computable" removed from the conclusion.
6. Bearer of the construct named (person and firm via relation; Pettit 2016).
7. Muldoon & Raekstad / cooperativism filed as voice/ownership, not exit.
8. Digital sovereignty not flattened to "centralize control"; infrastructural strand acknowledged.
9. Algorithmacy novelty narrowed to triadic setting + competence→standing (DeVito conceded).
10. Cotter & Reisdorf restored; Klonick 2020; Schegg 2024 / ECN 2017 OTA numbers sourced.

**HANDOFF §0c / §0g empirics (claimed closed — re-check, do not assume):** Apple €500M (European
Commission, 2025b / CELEX 52025DMA100109); P2B repeal COM(2025) 837 (European Commission, 2025a);
COM(2026) 178 gloss "limited demand"; Art. 22 scoped to natural persons; Directive 2024/2831 confers
nothing until transposition on 2 December 2026.

G. §7 closes on the diagnostic splitting what research treats as one capability; §8 opens on that

H. §7 opens by retrieving the diagnostic as the tool that now sorts the institutions just said to

I. Style: §3 political-will foil gone; §2.2 “point matters more” gone; Fratini adjective
